headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 15, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a 4-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Max Meyer earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 9 strikeouts. Bryan Reynolds led the Pirates' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. The San Diego Padres also secured a win, defeating the Baltimore Orioles 5-2 behind a strong outing from Rodolfo Durán, who led the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. The Washington Nationals dominated the Seattle Mariners, winning 10-1 behind a strong outing from Miles Mikolas. The New York Yankees secured an 8-3 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Camilo Doval earning the win in relief.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries. New York Mets first baseman Jorge Polanco has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a right wrist contusion. Christian Scott, also of the New York Mets, has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 12, 2026, with a right hip impingement. The Kansas City Royals have also been hit by injuries, with Carlos Estévez placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left foot contusion and Vinnie Pasquantino placed on the 10-day injured list with a right hamate fracture.

The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their pitching staff with the acquisition of right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for RHP Denis Samudio and cash. The Seattle Mariners have traded RHP Yosver Zulueta to the Chicago Cubs for cash, while the Cleveland Guardians have traded RF Nolan Jones and cash to the Chicago White Sox for future considerations.

top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 4-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Max Meyer earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 9 strikeouts. Bryan Reynolds led the Pirates' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Orioles 5-2**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a 5-2 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Rodolfo Durán leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Walker Buehler earned the win with 5 strong innings, striking out 5 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Nationals Rout Mariners 10-1**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dominated the Seattle Mariners, winning 10-1 behind a strong outing from Miles Mikolas. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Blue Jays 8-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured an 8-3 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Camilo Doval earning the win in relief. José Caballero led the Yankees' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Place Jorge Polanco on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: New York Mets first baseman Jorge Polanco has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a right wrist contusion. The injury will keep him sidelined for an extended period.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire RHP Connor Seabold in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for RHP Denis Samudio and cash.
